jobs.description:
About Us

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About This Role

JOB TITLE:
Director, Engineering

The Director of Engineering for Substation is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, design, and implementation of Substation projects. This role involves managing a team of engineers and technical staff, ensuring that projects meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards, and supporting the company's strategic objectives. The Director will collaborate with other departments, stakeholders, and external partners to drive innovation, efficiency, and operational excellence in the company's transmission and substation engineering activities.

What You'll Do

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and technical professionals.
Establish and maintain a high-performance culture, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and talents.
Oversee the planning, design, and execution of transmission and substation projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission and substation systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards in all engineering activities.
Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission and substation infrastructure.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments, such as Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, regulators, contractors, and suppliers.
Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and regulatory meetings, advocating for the company's interests and promoting its capabilities.

What You'll Bring

Minimum of 15 years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
P.E. license required.
Proven track record of successfully leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
Strong technical expertise in structural, civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering, with a comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices.
Expert knowledge of electric utility engineering and construction standards.
Advanced knowledge of utility industry processes including scheduling, contracts, coordinating and managing all disciplines.
Excellent business acumen and experience managing departmental budgets.
Knowledge of process and procedures for project controls and estimates.
Experience interpreting internal and external business issues, recommending best practices, mitigating risk and solving complex problems.
Demonstrated experience supporting external customers.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans, drive innovation, and achieve business objectives.
Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, NEC, NESC, and others.
Able to deal with ambiguity and ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and determine priorities in a complex environment.

The Director of Process Engineering oversees key site engineering functions, including process engineering, product commercialization, capital and project delivery, process reliability, controls engineering, and project management. As a member of the Noblesville Site Lead Team, the Director helps shape site strategy, organizational development, and cross-functional alignment.

Work Schedule:
Monday-Friday 8:00am – 5:00pm

Leads the transfer and commercialization of new products and processes at the site in partnership with R&D.

Manages specifications for process-specific materials and components.

Oversees the timely completion of process-related nonconformances, CAPAs, change controls, and complaints.
Supports all site quality audits and inspections.

Partners with Procurement to manage relationships and resolve issues with key equipment manufacturers.

Promotes a culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement within Engineering.
Provides ongoing coaching and professional development to strengthen team members’ technical capabilities and regulatory knowledge.
Conducts regular performance reviews and establishes clear objectives and performance measures.
Partners with HR to recruit qualified talent aligned with the company’s culture of excellence.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
At least 15 years of engineering experience in the pharmaceutical industry; radiopharmaceutical experience preferred.

Demonstrated ability to establish a vision and lead cultural change.
Experience leading cross-functional teams.
Self-directed and fully accountable for department performance, deliverables, and timelines with limited supervisor guidance.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Ability and willingness to work near radioactive products.

Must be able to work indoors and outdoors with exposure to mechanical/moving parts, hazards including corrosive, flammable and toxic material, dust, dirt, odors, and irritants. 
Willingness to complete safety training within allotted timeframes, and work in a team-based environment.

jobs.description:
Eleven Recruiting is seeking a Head of Engineering for a growing aerospace and defense company developing supersonic ramjet munitions, multi-mission missiles, and autonomous vertical launch systems. This role will own system architecture, technical decisions, and engineering execution across multiple sites and programs, guiding products from development through testing and production.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with deep experience in complex hardware, embedded software, and systems integration. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, resolve critical technical trade-offs, and build the engineering capabilities needed to scale. The company’s approach emphasizes rapid iteration, operational feedback, and production through a distributed network of manufacturing partners.

Responsibilities

Own system architecture and technical baselines across airframe structures, propulsion, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), embedded software, and avionics.
Serve as the final technical authority for architecture decisions, requirements allocation, and technical risk acceptance.
Lead requirements flow-down, interface control, subsystem integration, and verification and validation.
Oversee the integration of embedded guidance, controls, and mission software with vehicle hardware.
Guide systems from prototype through qualification and production, addressing manufacturability and scalability early in development.
Provide technical sign-off at key readiness gates, including ground testing, qualification, and flight/live-fire testing.
Align engineering leaders across sites around shared architectures, technical standards, and program priorities.
Build and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams, identify capability gaps, and develop staffing plans.
Establish engineering processes that support rapid development and continuous improvement while maintaining technical rigor.
Partner with software and data platform teams to incorporate operational performance and cost-per-effect data into design decisions.
Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executives, government customers, and program partners.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or software engineering, or a related technical field.
12+ years of engineering experience, including system-level ownership of a complex hardware/software product.
Experience as a Chief Engineer, Head of Engineering, Systems Architect, or equivalent technical authority.
Demonstrated technical depth in systems architecture, embedded software, and hardware integration.
Experience leading a vehicle or weapon system through design reviews, test campaigns, and readiness gates.
A first-principles approach to problem-solving, with the ability to challenge assumptions and make sound technical decisions.
Strong leadership and communication skills, including experience guiding multidisciplinary teams and explaining technical decisions to executives and customers.
U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Department of Defense security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree or PhD in a related technical field.
Experience with missiles, guided munitions, or hypersonic/supersonic vehicles.
Experience transitioning hardware/software products from prototype to production, ideally through a distributed manufacturing model.
Background in embedded real-time systems, GNC, or avionics software.
Experience supporting DoD, DARPA, or classified programs.
Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools and formal systems engineering practices.
Experience applying continuous deployment or iterative development methods to hardware programs.
Active TS/SCI or a previously held security clearance.

We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

Job Description

Renesas is seeking a Senior Manager, Web Engineering
to lead the organization responsible for building, operating, and improving Renesas.com and related digital platforms. This role manages a global team of approximately 30 full-time employees and contractors across development, QA, infrastructure, production operations, and emerging AI-enabled web initiatives.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone with the depth to understand complex engineering decisions and the desire to lead through strategy, team design, operating discipline, and cross-functional influence. The ideal candidate is highly technical, but does not need to personally own every implementation detail. They should be able to evaluate tradeoffs, set direction, build trust, and ensure the right technical decisions are being made.

The role reports to the Director of Web and Tech Docs at Renesas and requires excellent communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to translate business and technical needs into clear priorities, scalable plans, and credible recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

GTM Engineering is an emerging function that sits between Revenue Operations and Software Engineering. This person designs, builds, and operates the data pipelines, enrichment workflows, AI agent deployments, and automated plays that the GTM team runs on. Every major SaaS company scaling AI-assisted GTM motions in 2026 is hiring for this role — it is the operational backbone that makes distribution, sales, and CS teams significantly more productive.

Internal tooling and dashboards — building the operational views that let GTM leadership see pipeline health, campaign performance, and agent effectiveness in real time

Has operated in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment where speed of iteration mattered more than perfection

First 90 Days

GTM tech stack audit complete — map of current tools, integration gaps, and automation opportunities documented
First 3 agent workflows deployed and in production (e.g., lead enrichment, outbound personalization, campaign QA)
Measurable time savings quantified — hours saved per GTM team member per week from automation

Dashboard or reporting layer built that gives GTM leadership a real-time view of agent performance and pipeline health

The Vice President, Infrastructure Operations & Security
provides strategic and operational leadership for the Company’s global technology environment. This role is accountable for aligning technology capabilities and investments with business priorities; protecting systems, networks, and data; and ensuring reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology services. The Vice President leads enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, service delivery, data governance, technology risk, vendor management, and IT financial management, while partnering with executive and functional leaders to enable growth, operational performance, and an effective employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Governance, and Business Partnership

Develop and execute a multi-year information technology strategy and roadmap aligned with the Company’s business objectives, operating model, growth plans, and customer requirements.
Advise executive leadership on technology trends, opportunities, risks, investment priorities, and the business impact of technology decisions.
Establish and lead enterprise technology governance, including demand intake, prioritization, architecture standards, project oversight, investment approvals, and benefits realization.
Partner with business and functional leaders to translate operational needs into scalable technology solutions and measurable outcomes.
Provide clear, timely reporting to executive leadership on technology performance, strategic initiatives, risks, resource utilization, service levels, and financial results.

Cybersecurity, Risk, and Compliance

Lead the Company’s cybersecurity strategy and program, including governance, risk assessment, identity and access management, security operations, vulnerability management, awareness, and incident response.
Ensure technology controls and practices support applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, customer, data privacy, and government contracting requirements, including relevant NIST, CMMC, and DFARS obligations where applicable.
Oversee business continuity, disaster recovery, data backup, crisis response, and technology resilience programs; ensure plans are documented, tested, and improved regularly.
Maintain effective technology risk management and control environments, including audit readiness, remediation tracking, third-party risk management, and appropriate escalation of material risks.

Infrastructure, Operations, and Service Delivery

Provide executive oversight of enterprise infrastructure, networks, cloud services, end-user computing, telecommunications, collaboration platforms, data centers, and related technology operations.
Ensure the availability, performance, security, scalability, and integrity of technology services supporting domestic and international operations.
Establish service management standards, service-level expectations, performance measures, and continuous improvement practices that deliver a consistent employee and customer experience.
Oversee major incidents and problem management, ensuring timely communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and organizational learning.

Enterprise Applications, Data, and Transformation

Provide executive oversight of the Company’s enterprise application portfolio, including ERP, HRIS, finance, operations, customer, collaboration, and other mission-critical platforms.
Lead technology-enabled transformation and modernization initiatives that improve productivity, standardize processes, strengthen controls, and reduce operating complexity.
Establish enterprise data governance, ownership, quality, retention, access, and reporting standards in partnership with business leaders.
Evaluate and responsibly deploy emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and cloud capabilities, based on business value, security, compliance, and risk.
Ensure applications and integrations are supported by appropriate lifecycle management, architecture, documentation, testing, change management, and adoption practices.

Financial, Vendor, and Portfolio Management

Develop and manage the technology operating and capital budgets, including workforce plans, forecasts, business cases, cost optimization, and financial controls.
Optimize the Company’s technology portfolio by addressing duplication, underutilized licenses, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
Establish standards for make, buy, build, cloud, outsourcing, and managed service decisions.
Lead strategic vendor and managed service provider relationships, including sourcing, contract negotiation, performance management, service-level compliance, risk, and value realization.
Oversee technology programs and projects to ensure disciplined planning, resource allocation, risk management, change management, and delivery against approved scope, schedule, budget, and outcomes.

Leadership and Talent

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, service-oriented technology organization with clear accountability, succession planning, and appropriate technical and leadership capabilities.
Establish goals, performance measures, operating rhythms, and development plans that promote execution, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Create a culture of cybersecurity awareness, operational discipline, customer service, transparency, and responsible technology use across the Company.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
At least 15 years of progressive information technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility for enterprise technology functions in a complex organization.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple technology disciplines, including infrastructure and operations, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, service delivery, technology governance, and vendor management.
Experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies, roadmaps, budgets, and transformation programs tied to measurable business outcomes.
Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, technology controls, data protection, business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management practices.
Proven ability to lead through influence, partner with executive and functional leaders, communicate complex technology issues in business terms, and make sound decisions under pressure.
Demonstrated success building teams, developing leaders, managing organizational change, and establishing a strong service and accountability culture.
Ability to travel as business needs require and to support critical events outside standard business hours.
Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance if required by the position or customer obligations.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in information technology, computer science, business administration, or a related field.
Leadership experience in government contracting, defense, security services, or another highly regulated and geographically dispersed environment.
Experience supporting global operations and navigating international data protection, security, and technology requirements.
Experience with cloud transformation, ERP and HRIS modernization, data governance, artificial intelligence, automation, and enterprise architecture.
Relevant professional certification, such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, PMP, ITIL, or a major cloud platform certification.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strategic and commercial mindset with the ability to connect technology investments to growth, risk reduction, cost efficiency, and operational performance.
Strong executive presence, judgment, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to balance long-term strategy with disciplined operational execution and service delivery.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, business case development, contract management, and total cost of ownership analysis.

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

Vice President Group Director, MarTech Strategist – Systems and Experience Engineering

Digitas is looking for a Vice President/Group Director, MarTech Strategist to help clients turn marketing technology and AI investments into measurable business value. This is a consulting role and, in this role, you will be deployed into client organizations to assess what they have, design what they need, build the case for the investment, and then help their people actually adopt it.

You will work across marketing, technology, data, operations, and experience teams to identify where AI and

automation can improve how work gets done, where human judgment matters most, and how new capabilities should be governed, measured, and adopted.

Assess client MarTech environments, workflows, data usage, vendor dependencies, and adoption gaps.

JOB DESCRIPTION

OCI is seeking a Senior Manager of Firmware Management to lead teams responsible for the strategy, delivery, validation, and lifecycle management of firmware across our global cloud infrastructure. This leader will manage engineers who build and operate firmware solutions for server platforms and critical hardware components, including BIOS/BMC, storage, networking, accelerators, and platform security technologies.

You will establish a high bar for firmware quality, security, fleet reliability, and operational excellence. Working across hardware engineering, infrastructure, security, supply-chain, and operations teams, you will drive safe firmware release processes—from vendor qualification and compatibility testing through staged deployment, monitoring, rollback, and incident response.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in systems and firmware with demonstrated people leadership. You are comfortable making risk-based decisions at hyperscale, developing engineering talent, and translating complex hardware and firmware concerns into clear operational plans.

Lead and develop a high-performing firmware engineering and management organization supporting OCI’s global infrastructure fleet.
Define the firmware lifecycle strategy for server and hardware platforms, including intake, qualification, release, deployment, maintenance, and end-of-life planning.

Ensure safe fleet deployment mechanisms, including phased rollouts, health monitoring, automated remediation, rollback plans, and operational readiness.
Establish measurable reliability, availability, security, and deployment KPIs; use telemetry and dashboards to identify risks and improve fleet health.
Lead investigation and resolution of complex firmware-related incidents, defects, regressions, and interoperability issues.
Partner with security teams to ensure firmware integrity, secure boot, vulnerability remediation, access control, and compliance requirements are met.
Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices that reduce manual operational work and improve repeatability of firmware updates.
Manage multiple medium- to large-scale programs, balancing technical risk, business priorities, customer impact, timelines, and available resources.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external hardware and firmware vendors; influence product roadmaps and escalation paths.

About Thintronics

Thintronics is solving one of the defining challenges in modern computing: moving massive amounts of data and power between chips at unprecedented speeds and densities.
As Moore's Law slows, performance is increasingly defined by advanced packaging, chiplet architectures, and high-density substrates. Thintronics has developed breakthrough dielectric materials that enable unprecedented interconnect density, signal integrity, and power delivery for next generation semiconductor packages.

Our technology spans chemistry, materials science, semiconductor processing, and electrical engineering, creating new possibilities for AI accelerators, high-performance computing, advanced networking, and 5G/6G infrastructure. We partner with leading semiconductor companies, including integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), foundries, substrate manufacturers, and outsourced assembly and testing (OSAT) partners, to help shape the future of advanced packaging.

Joining Thintronics means joining a small, highly accomplished team where technical excellence, curiosity, and innovation drive everything we do.

About the Role

Thintronics is seeking an exceptional Director / Sr Director of Engineering, Advanced Packaging
to lead the integration of our breakthrough materials into the world's most advanced semiconductor packaging platforms.

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this individual will define and execute Thintronics' advanced packaging strategy, serving as the technical leader responsible for translating cutting edge materials innovation into manufacturable, high volume semiconductor solutions.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role requiring deep expertise in advanced packaging, semiconductor process integration, customer engagement, and cross functional technical leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, manufacturing partners, and internal R&D teams to accelerate commercialization while helping build Thintronics' packaging organization for future growth.

This role carries equal responsibility for the direct management of Thintronics' engineering organization, including the Process Integration team, Substrate Manufacturer and OSAT Engagement, and the Electrical Engineering, ECAD, Mechanical Engineering, and Reliability functions.

This position offers a rare opportunity to influence product strategy, customer success, and the future direction of one of the semiconductor industry's most promising materials technology companies.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

Define and lead Thintronics' advanced semiconductor packaging strategy.
Develop technology roadmaps for integrating Thintronics' dielectric materials into next generation package architectures.
Drive process integration strategies that maximize electrical performance, manufacturability, reliability, and yield.
Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout product development and customer qualification.

Customer & Partner Engagement

Support customer evaluations, qualifications, and production ramps.
Represent Thintronics at executive level technical discussions and industry conferences.

Process Integration

Lead development and optimization of advanced packaging integration flows.
Guide process development across dielectric deposition, patterning, metallization, via formation, reliability testing, and package integration.
Drive Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, process characterization, and yield improvement initiatives.
Establish best practices for process control, manufacturability, and reliability.

Product Development

Collaborate closely with Chemistry, Materials Science, Device Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Applications Engineering teams.

Help prioritize R&D investments based on customer needs and market opportunities.

Recruit, develop, and coach high performing engineers.
Establish technical standards, engineering processes, and best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Strategic Leadership

Contribute to Thintronics' long term technology and commercialization strategy.
Support technical due diligence with customers, investors, and strategic partners.
Evaluate emerging semiconductor packaging technologies and competitive developments.
Work closely with executive leadership to identify future market opportunities.

Required Qualifications

Ph.D. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
12+ years of experience in semiconductor packaging, process integration, or advanced packaging technologies.
Demonstrated technical leadership in advanced semiconductor packaging within a leading semiconductor manufacturer, substrate supplier, OSAT, equipment company, or materials company.
Deep expertise in semiconductor package development, process integration, and manufacturing.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and cross functional technical programs.
Prior experience directly managing a team of direct reports, with a demonstrated track record of hiring, developing, and leading engineering staff.
Working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals, including signal integrity and power integrity design trade offs, as they relate to advanced package design and integration.
Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM), design rule check (DRC), and other ECAD/mechanical design verification practices used in package development.
Strong customer facing experience supporting technology development and commercialization.
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills.

Leading semiconductor manufacturers

Lead the evolution of the team from traditional datacenter and infrastructure operations toward AWS-native cloud application engineering.
Manage and operate AWS PaaS services supporting NetDocuments SaaS applications as our public cloud footprint expands.
Establish cloud-native operational practices that improve reliability, scalability, automation, and engineering efficiency.

Partner with product engineering teams to align Cloud Operations capabilities with product roadmaps and technical priorities.

Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, telemetry, and operational visibility are incorporated into infrastructure and application environments.
Provide leadership for incident response subject matter experts in alignment with the established Incident Management process.
Identify opportunities to improve production reliability through automation, operational standards, and proactive infrastructure improvements.
Ensure Cloud Operations standards for observability, incident response, reliability, and security are represented within product engineering teams.

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop engineers through a significant evolution in the team’s technical responsibilities and operating model.
Build development plans that help engineers expand from datacenter and infrastructure operations into AWS-native platform engineering.
Establish certification paths, hands-on learning opportunities, and technical development plans that prepare the team for increased cloud ownership.
Build a team capable of serving as both engineering contributors and trusted operational advisors to the broader organization.

Thintronics is solving one of the defining challenges in modern computing: moving massive amounts of data and power between chips at unprecedented speeds and densities.
As Moore's Law slows, performance is increasingly defined by advanced packaging, chiplet architectures, and high-density substrates. Thintronics has developed breakthrough dielectric materials that enable unprecedented interconnect density, signal integrity, and power delivery for next generation semiconductor packages.

Our technology spans chemistry, materials science, semiconductor processing, and electrical engineering, creating new possibilities for AI accelerators, high-performance computing, advanced networking, and 5G/6G infrastructure. We partner with leading semiconductor companies, including integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), foundries, substrate manufacturers, and outsourced assembly and testing (OSAT) partners, to help shape the future of advanced packaging.

Joining Thintronics means joining a small, highly accomplished team where technical excellence, curiosity, and innovation drive everything we do.

About the Role

Thintronics is seeking an exceptional Director / Sr Director of Engineering, Advanced Packaging
to lead the integration of our breakthrough materials into the world's most advanced semiconductor packaging platforms.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role requiring deep expertise in advanced packaging, semiconductor process integration, customer engagement, and cross functional technical leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, manufacturing partners, and internal R&D teams to accelerate commercialization while helping build Thintronics' packaging organization for future growth.

This role carries equal responsibility for the direct management of Thintronics' engineering organization, including the Process Integration team, Substrate Manufacturer and OSAT Engagement, and the Electrical Engineering, ECAD, Mechanical Engineering, and Reliability functions.

This position offers a rare opportunity to influence product strategy, customer success, and the future direction of one of the semiconductor industry's most promising materials technology companies.

What You'll Do

Define and lead Thintronics' advanced semiconductor packaging strategy.
Develop technology roadmaps for integrating Thintronics' dielectric materials into next generation package architectures.
Drive process integration strategies that maximize electrical performance, manufacturability, reliability, and yield.
Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout product development and customer qualification.

Guide process development across dielectric deposition, patterning, metallization, via formation, reliability testing, and package integration.

Establish best practices for process control, manufacturability, and reliability.

Product Development

Evaluate emerging semiconductor packaging technologies and competitive developments.
Work closely with executive leadership to identify future market opportunities.

Ph.D. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
12+ years of experience in semiconductor packaging, process integration, or advanced packaging technologies.

Define lifecycle metrics and initiatives that drive sustainable growth and customer value.
Push the edge of what’s possible with AI for our borrowers, staying ahead of new tools and models as the landscape evolves.
Partner with PMO and Technology to operationalize evaluation frameworks that ensure prioritization reflects measurable business impact and scalability.
Bring a point of view on where AI creates real advantage for borrowers, and where it introduces risk instead.
Anticipate dependencies across initiatives and align stakeholders to balance near-term performance with long-term platform evolution.
Translate business goals into structured, data-informed product hypotheses, plans, and measurable success metrics.

Establish pre-launch success criteria and ensure every initiative begins with a clear definition of impact, aside from defining roadmaps at the epic level.
Lead quarterly and annual reviews to evaluate portfolio performance, ROI, adoption, and lifecycle impact, including the performance of AI-driven or automated capabilities against lending-specific KPIs (e.g., approval rate, time-to-fund, loss rate, servicing cost).
Collaborate with Data and Finance to evolve how FairSquare measures product contribution to growth, retention, and efficiency.
Encourage a culture of learning through reflection, iteration, and data-driven decision-making.
Model calm, rational decision-making under ambiguity — providing clarity when direction is uncertain.
Promote collaboration, informed judgment, and organizational agility by fostering open communication, constructive dialogue, and partnership built on trust.
Codify and scale the way Product leads across FairSquare — embedding structure, clarity, and continuous learning in every initiative.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Required

A genuine drive to help small business owners succeed — seeing product outcomes not just as metrics, but as ways to empower real entrepreneurs and communities.
8–10+ years in Product Management, with a proven record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fintech, SaaS, or SMB lending.
Hands-on fluency with AI tools: you use them daily to research, analyze, prototype, and accelerate your own work, and can demonstrate how doing so has improved the quality, speed, or depth of your product decisions. Experience shipping AI-powered product features is a plus.
Technically conversant: able to partner with engineers to understand technical and AI/LLM tradeoffs and write requirements that account for them.
A player-coach mindset: comfortable owning strategy through execution personally, doing the work of shaping insight, spec, and prototype.
Strong track record of turning strategic goals into measurable outcomes that improve customer and business performance.
Deep experience defining and applying frameworks to structure decisions and communicate product rationale.
Proven ability to drive lifecycle impact from acquisition and activation to retention and revenue.
Expertise in balancing borrower needs, business value, and operational feasibility in a multi-stakeholder environment.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills — able to influence executive levels through structured reasoning and clarity.
Comfortable operating in dynamic, data-informed environments; disciplined yet pragmatic.
Strongly preferred: experience operating within the SMB financing, embedded finance, or lending marketplace ecosystem. Familiarity with technologies that enable the full product development lifecycle — including customer data systems, workflow automation, partner integrations, analytics, and digital experience platforms — is highly valued.

Physical Demands

Working in a temperature-controlled office environment.
Sitting at a desk for long periods of time while viewing multiple computer screen monitors.
Potential lifting of boxes around 5-10lbs.

FairSquare is building the future of SMB finance. We combine technology, partnerships, and insight to make business funding faster, more transparent, and more personalized. Our Product team leads with structure, clarity, and measurable impact — and we’re looking for a leader who can do the same.

FairSquare and its family of brands has been serving the small business community since 1999. About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.
